study.question: Does the failed rank48 scorer primarily suffer from reduced initial product energy, or does its quality gap persist when initial energy is controlled? Can the energy-restored rank48 pass the unchanged click-quality and measured prediction-cost screen?
study.hypothesis: Observed: g2-r0076-scorer_rank_reference reproduced g2-r0075-coordinate_weight_direct click AUC0.6675182598431633 exactly. Factor64 control AUC0.6674172008812335; raw rank48 AUC0.6658880175030177, a0.0015291833782158 loss versus factor64; channel56 AUC0.6670104276335854. Factor64 missed loss<=0.000100 against the unfactored reference by0.0000010589619298 and its p50 fell only1.75%, so it is not a utility success. Rank48 p50 fell2.07% against unfactored reference, but p95 rose3.02% and quality failed. These are single-seed validation observations, not mechanism proof. Across trajectories: initial embedding12/scorer-half and tower-half reductions were negative; residual allocation and semantic owner partition yielded local gains; owner context rank96 preserved quality but rank88 and low-rank dense replacements did not. g2-r0064-energy_rank96_low AUC0.6674020187039185 versus native96 AUC0.6675003890552496, while g2-r0064-energy_rank88_high AUC0.6671593751174643 versus native88 AUC0.6671251297972951 did not recover quality. These earlier energy controls concerned a buy-context map, not this shared scorer: they weaken a general energy-only explanation but do not test scorer transfer. No novelty claim; this is a targeted diagnostic after a failed implementation. Hypothesis, unverified: restoring the rank48 factor product to E64 may recover a substantial part of the loss without restoring the16 deleted linear directions or adding inference work. A crossed rank64/E48 control tests whether lowering energy hurts without rank restriction. The primary mediator is not claimed: Dice running statistics and factor-optimizer geometry are alternative paths.

study.proposed_difference: A2x2 design: ranks{64,48} crossed with target initial stored-coordinate product energies{E64,E48}. High64 and low48 replay the prior source bytes. Low64 and high48 compute g=sqrt(E_target/E_rank) on the fresh untrained scorer singular spectrum, multiply retained singular values by g, then use the existing balanced factor split. All forward methods, capacities within a rank, and training exposure remain identical. Energy targeting changes initialization only; there is no learned template, cache, gain in forward or new data.
predictions: Verify initial FP32 product energy is E64/E48 as assigned (relative error<=1e-4); ranks64/48 retain64 output channels and actual scorer weights64*(304+64)=23552 /48*(304+64)=17664 respectively. High versus low energy at a fixed rank must have identical parameter counts and forward code.

Directional scale support requires click AUC(high48)-AUC(low48)>=0.000100 and AUC(high64)-AUC(low64)>=0.000100. Substantial energy-rescue support additionally requires high48 gain>=0.0007645916891079, half the prior factor64-minus-raw48 gap. Calculate the two matched-energy rank effects and difference-in-differences; divergent signs imply interaction/limited explanation rather than energy-only support. Thresholds are predeclared diagnostics, not statistical significance.

Utility thresholds remain fixed: loss<=0.000100 versus a contemporaneous unfactored incumbent AND absolute AUC>=0.6674018907227037; p50 latency<=98% of reference, p95<=102%, inference seconds<=102%. Current four cells are a mechanism screen, with historical unfactored AUC/cost only a provisional anchor. They cannot establish utility without a subsequent contemporary unfactored replay and paired candidate timing.

Constructor-only rescaling should add no inference work or persistent storage. Any measured rank48 speed benefit must be observed, not inferred from parameter/MAC arithmetic; current scope measures training/prediction cost on full protocol.
falsifiers: Native64 and raw48 bridges fail to reproduce AUC0.6674172008812335 and0.6658880175030177 within1e-6: stop interpretation and diagnose host/source/protocol differences within budget; do not explain mismatch as a mechanism effect.

Energy restoration fails the predeclared directional or substantial-recovery criteria: reject that level of energy explanation for this scorer implementation; retain null/negative results. Persistent matched-energy rank gaps oppose an energy-only account but do not prove all scorer capacity necessary.
Any AUC-preservation or prediction-cost bound fails: reject efficiency utility for that candidate, even if norms, parameters, training time or auxiliaries improve.

Any padding/mask/target-action restriction, gradient ownership, factor storage, unchanged initialization or evaluation-buffer integrity check fails: the implementation is invalid, not scientific counterevidence.
alternative_explanations: Equal product norm in stored coordinates does not equal empirical activation variance or effective ordinary-coordinate norm.
Rank removal changes singular directions; energy scaling changes both factor magnitudes and thus AdamW/clipping/BF16 trajectories. It does not isolate Dice statistics as the mediator.
One fixed seed cannot estimate seed variation; same-seed replays test reproducibility only. Timing order and hardware noise remain.
The initial orthogonal weight singular spectrum is unrelated to learned useful directions; matching its norm cannot replace lost directions.
Auxiliary tasks have no item/scorer parameter gradient ownership, so their AUC changes may be downstream of click-driven embedding dynamics. Auxiliary mean is never the selection score.
Prior selection over many same-seed variants can overfit validation; no generalization or significance claim follows from one screen.
